description: This file defines enumeration and data structures related to talk commands, specifically for push-to-talk (PTT) actions such as start, stop, cancel, and one-time actions, including associated payload data structures.

methods.name: init(captureId:)
methods.description: Initializer for OpenClawTalkPTTStartPayload and OpenClawTalkPTTStopPayload, used to create instances with specified capture ID, transcript, and status.
